title: Grok Build: Another Coding AI for Musk's Empire
caption: Elon Musk's xAI just dropped "Grok Build," a new coding agent. Another player in the crowded dev AI space, but with xAI's unique spin. We break down what it is and why it matters for your workflow. Tap the link in bio for the waitlist.

slides.headline: Grok Build wants to write your code. Do you *really* want it to?
slides.sub: Elon Musk just launched a coding agent to compete with GitHub Copilot.

slides.title: xAI's New Coding Agent
slides.body: Grok Build is xAI's latest offering, designed to assist developers with coding tasks. It aims to integrate Grok's conversational capabilities directly into the development workflow, offering code generation, debugging, and explanation.

slides.title: What Grok Build *Promises*
bullets: Accelerated code generation for common functions.
Natural language explanations of complex code blocks.
slides.footer: All powered by Grok's real-time information access.

audiences.body: Developers keen to experiment with new AI tools and integrate Grok's distinct personality into their coding.
Those already invested in the xAI ecosystem or curious about Musk's vision for developer tooling.

slides.title: xAI's *Bigger* Picture
slides.footer: Grok Build expands xAI beyond general chat into specialized, revenue-generating applications.

slides.sub: See how xAI's coding agent works in your development workflow.
